name: Being An Encourager
overview: Scripture reveals that being an encourager involves speaking words that uplift and bring joy to the heart, as pleasant and timely words are compared to honeycomb and golden apples, sweet and healthful to the soul (Proverbs 12:25; 16:24; 25:11). Believers who are strong are called to support the weak, bearing their burdens rather than seeking self-pleasure (Romans 15:1). Words should be carefully chosen to build others up and minister grace, avoiding corrupt communication (Ephesians 4:29). Daily exhortation is vital to prevent spiritual hardening caused by sin’s deceitfulness, emphasizing the ongoing need for encouragement within the body of Christ (Hebrews 3:13).
